cards.claim: Coneo won the silver medal in the 2014 U23 Pan-American Cup and helped her national team finish sixth in the volleyball tournament at the 2014 Central American and Caribbean Games.
cards.quote: Coneo won the silver medal in the 2014 U23 Pan-American Cup held in Peru, when they lost the gold medal match 1-3 to the Dominican Republic. She helped her national team to end up in the sixth place in the volleyball tournament held in the 2014 Central American and Caribbean Games in Veracruz, Mexico.

cards.claim: Coneo participated in the 2016 FIVB Volleyball World Grand Prix.
cards.quote: [ 29 ] Coneo participated in the 2016 FIVB Volleyball World Grand Prix [ 30 ] qualifying to the Final Four , [ 31 ] but losing the bronze medal match 2–3 to Peru .
